summary: Extraction Vision Document for Oren's Content-First Media Team Architecture. Maps 12 net-new concepts not covered by existing Oren skill domains. Proposes a 5th skill domain (oren-content-team-architecture) with 12 workflows across 3 tiers. Includes leverage analysis (5/5 deployability, 5/5 revenue potential), cross-expert stacking map with 9 compound chains, and full gap analysis showing this fills the missing TEAM ARCHITECTURE layer between individual-creator workflows and content operations frameworks.
